scope: Stipulated E8 level-one vacuum lattice representation; separated-point boundary currents

reverse_bootstrap.retained: Discrete E8 closure fixes g_car=5 and the eight normalization witnesses within its framework
reverse_bootstrap.not_inferred: No automatic raw-kernel field pullback, 4D statistics, field-dependent kinetic operator or source state/time

boundary_current_blocks.meaning: 40 D5 roots +12 D3 roots +8 Cartan currents

vertex_definition: V_alpha(z)=e_alpha :exp(i alpha.X(z)):; declared ordered lattice cocycle
Cartan_Ward_rule: mean_i=sum_j d_i.alpha_j/(u_i-z_j); covariance_ij=d_i.d_j/(u_i-u_j)^2; recurse over means and pairings multiplying the root-vertex response
formal_current_source_series: Z[J]/Z[0]=sum_n (1/n!) integral <product_i (sum_alpha J_alpha(z_i)V_alpha(z_i)+sum_a J_a(z_i)H^a(z_i))>; current_response computes mixed coefficients only away from diagonals

checks.E8_character_scope: Known original v156 control; no new equality of full NS and E8 local fields
checks.positivity_scope: Root-state norms in the stipulated positive E8 lattice Fock representation, not a raw P1 reflection-positivity proof

nonabelian_probe.meaning: Current responses are non-Gaussian even in the lattice/free-boson realization; no native Yukawa or independent boson-pair transfer is inferred

requires_for_physical_P1: An original field insertion map into this representation, with local domains, charge, statistics and physical time
